styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Tengwang Pavilion, Bayi Square and the 1927 uprising sites.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Spicy Gan cooking, rice noodles and street stalls.

stays.why: Old-town feel near Tengwang Pavilion and Bayi Square; easy metro and short taxi rides to most sights.
Central and busy; close to Bayi Square, shopping streets and many cheap noodle shops.
New riverside district with modern hotels and skyline views; metro links across the river.
Quieter and greener, near the lake and university area; good value if you don't mind longer rides.

food: Try Gan cuisine: it is spicy and often stir-fried. Ask for 'bu la' (not spicy) if you need it mild.
Nanchang rice noodles (banfen) with peanuts and chili are the classic cheap breakfast; expect a few CNY to about ¥15.
Wash it down with wa-guan-tang, a salty soup steamed in small clay pots.
Evening street food near universities and old lanes is cheap and lively; pick stalls with a queue of locals.
Prices are low by big-city standards: a simple meal often costs ¥15–40, a sit-down dinner ¥50–120. Check the bill on the day.
more_time: Add a day trip to Lushan or Jingdezhen if you have a car or join a tour; travel times vary, so check on the day.
Porcelain fans can spend a half-day at the provincial museum and ceramics displays; confirm opening hours before you go.
Swap one city day for a riverside walk and a slower evening at Tengwang Pavilion to see the lights.

recommend.why: One night covers Tengwang Pavilion, Bayi Square and the old lanes; add a second night for museums and a slower riverside evening.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 11°C, lows near 4°C. Pack a warm coat.
Still chilly, highs near 13°C. Rain on about 13 days, so bring an umbrella.
Milder at 18°C highs but wet: about 16 rain days.
Pleasant spring: highs near 23°C, lows near 15°C. Good walking weather.
Warm and humid, highs near 27°C; frequent rain (about 17 days).
Hot and wet: highs near 30°C, about 20 rain days. Plan indoor breaks.
Hot: highs near 33°C, lows near 27°C. Go out early or after sunset.
Hottest month, highs near 34°C. Carry water and seek shade.
Cooling to highs near 30°C; rain drops to about 8 days.
Best month: highs near 24°C, lows near 17°C, only about 7 rain days.
Mild at 19°C highs; about 10 rain days. A light jacket helps.
Cold again: highs near 12°C, lows near 5°C, but drier with about 7 rain days.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical: hot, wet summers and cool, fairly dry winters. Spring and autumn are the best times to walk the city.

items.title: Best time: April and October
items.text: Highs around 23–24°C with comfortable nights. Ideal for pavilions, squares and riverside walks.

items.title: Hot, humid summer (June to August)
items.text: Highs of 30–34°C and muggy nights near 27°C. Do sights early morning; rest indoors at midday.

items.title: Wettest in spring and early summer
items.text: March to June brings 15–20 rain days a month. Keep a compact umbrella and a backup indoor plan.

items.title: Cool winters (December to February)
items.text: Highs of 11–13°C and lows of 4–5°C. Bring a warm coat; buildings can feel cold.

items.title: Drier autumn
items.text: September and October see rain on only about 7–8 days. Good odds of clear days.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light layers and rain gear for spring and summer; a warm coat for winter; comfortable shoes for walking and metro trips.

transit.best: Metro for cross-city trips; Didi or a metered taxi for short hops and late nights.

modes.text: 4 lines cross the city and a 5th is under construction. Cheap and avoids traffic; check the map for your stop.
About ¥2 flat, more for double-deckers. Good coverage but slower in traffic.
Taxis start at ¥6–8 and charge about ¥1.9/km, with a 20% night surcharge 23:00–05:00. Didi works well; tell drivers 'da biao' (use the meter).
Driving is busy in the centre. Only worth it for out-of-town trips; check licence rules first.
Easy in the centre and around Bayi Square and the old lanes. Use metro or taxi for longer hops.
Shared bikes and e-bikes are common. Park in marked zones and wear a helmet.
